title: Consolidated Security Intake Accelerator and Account-aware Routing
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Problem: Enterprise customers routinely submit security & compliance asks (SOC2 questions, ISO checklists, DPA clauses, HIPAA attestations, GDPR data residency requests, and vendor questionnaires). Current intake is fragmented across support tickets, emails, and ad-hoc Slack threads; time-to-first-response varies 3-14 days and engineering/product handoffs are manual. Goal: build a consolidated Security Intake Accelerator that (1) classifies requests automatically, (2) maps asks to evidence artifacts and existing controls, (3) computes a risk-weighted priority score, and (4) routes to an account-aware lane (fast-track / standard / low-touch) with SLOs and automated evidence bundling. Scope: non-bug enterprise security/compliance requests only (no incidents). Includes integration with Confluence/Drive evidence store, routing rules service, and Console triage dashboard. Out of scope for this ticket: building new cryptographic features or new legal templates (legal will supply updated DPA clauses in a follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Auto-classifier routes >= 85% of incoming security asks into one of: SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, Vendor Questionnaire, or Other
Priority score calculated and visible on each ticket with components: base_risk, data_sensitivity, account_tier, coverage_index
Routing lanes created with SLOs: Fast-track (48h), Standard (10d), Low-touch (30d) and initial automation for evidence bundling enabled for Fast-track
Console triage view shows incoming queue, predicted lane, priority_score, and linked evidence artifacts for each ticket
Integration hooks to Confluence/Drive return at least one candidate evidence doc for 70% of classified asks during alpha
Playbook for manual escalations and legal handoffs documented and reviewed by Legal & Security
End-to-end tests added for classifier -> router -> evidence-bundler happy path (unit + integration)
notes_and_updates: 2026-03-01 - Created: initial problem statement and success criteria. Raised need for Legal review. Aisha.
2026-03-03 - Engineering spike complete: prototype classifier using keyword+embedding ensemble yields 82% F1 on a 400-sample labeled set (ENG-41288). Marco to prioritize refinements.

2026-03-06 - Product review: decided to use account_tier weighting (enterprise customers get +2 priority) to ensure commercial SLAs are respected. Trade-off: may increase False Positives for smaller accounts but acceptable for alpha.
2026-03-08 - Design feedback: UI should surface 'why' classifier chose a lane (top-3 signals) to reduce trust friction. Added as a small UX task (DES-1254).
2026-03-10 - Legal: provided canonical DPA and sample SOC2 evidence list; requested ability to mark docs as 'sensitive' to restrict bundling (link to Confluence below).
2026-03-12 - Infra: created evidence store index and search API prototype (ENG-40123). Need to add ACL checks before auto-bundling.

2026-03-14 - PM sync: Agreed to alpha cut with Fast-track automation and human-in-the-loop for Standard lane. Cut scope for low-touch automation to Q2. Assigned Marco and Eng pair for classifier tuning.
decision_log: Classifier approach: keyword-tiered ruleset + semantic embeddings ensemble chosen over pure rules due to modelability and maintainability (reasons: quicker precision lift, easier to surface top signals).
Routing lanes: settled on three lanes for alpha (Fast-track / Standard / Low-touch) with clearly documented SLOs to set expectations with customers and sales.
Evidence bundling: initially only attach non-sensitive Confluence/Drive docs and require a manual approval step for documents marked sensitive. Full auto-bundling deferred to Q2 pending ACL support.

Priority formula: priority_score = round( base_risk*3 + data_sensitivity*2 + account_tier*2 - coverage_index*1 ). Coverage_index is 0..3 where higher means more existing controls documented. This was chosen for transparency and easy auditability.
Security review: end-to-end flow will undergo Security Architecture review prior to GA; early review requested and scheduled (security review required = true).
